biography_english:
A Bakram formerly with the Liberation Front. He once taught at the Mages Academy of the former Kingdom of Valeria. He was banished from Heim for opposing Brantyn, and then joined the Liberation Front. He did not share their values, though, and so he parted ways with them.
  He then fought for the Resistance until a dispute with {hero} led to his departure.
biography_spanish:
Bakram que pertenecio al Frente de Liberacion. Fue profesor en la Academia de Magia del antiguo Reino de Valeria. Fue desterrado de Heim por oponerse a Brantyn y luego se unio al Frente de Liberacion. No compartia sus valores y decidio seguir su propio camino.            
  Luego lucho por la Resistencia hasta que una disputa con {hero} llevo a su salida.

biography_english: A Walister hailing from Krysaro who serves the Walister Resistance. She and her brother took shelter with the Resistance after their parents died in the first engagement between Galgastani and Walister forces. Her brother was captured by the Galgastani and taken to Balmamusa, where he became a victim of the massacre. Arycelle now hunts those responsible for the killings.
biography_spanish: Walister de Krysaro que sirve a la Resistencia walister. Ella y su hermano se refugiaron en la Resistencia tras la muerte de sus padres en el primer combate entre las fuerzas galgastanesas y walister. Su hermano fue capturado por los galgastaneses y llevado a Balmamusa, donde fue victima de la masacre. Arycelle busca ahora a los responsables de la matanza.

biography_english:

A blind swordsman from a foreign land.
  {hero} went to his aid when he was pursued by Resistance forces. He petitioned to join the Order of {order} after learning {hero} was at war with the Dark Knights.
  He holds them accountable for his loss of sight, but will not say what led to it.
